caption:
The weeks before a planned operation can be some of the most useful weeks of your rehab.

Prehab means building strength, fitness and confidence before surgery. Research suggests people who do this before some joint operations often find early recovery more manageable. It's also a chance to learn your first rehab exercises while you feel well, and to set up your home for the first days back.

Your surgical team's advice always comes first, so check with them before starting anything new and follow any limits they set.

Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can build a prehab plan around your procedure and your life. Book online via the link in bio.
